VcuLedDigitBank.description: Eight LED/LCD frame bytes (0x200021c6..0x200021cd) holding the two-digit display: tens digit c6..c8, icon bits in c9, units digit ca..cc and a segment byte in cd. Other frame bytes belong to other packets.

fields.name: tens_glyph_a
fields.description: Tens digit segment byte A from glyph table seg_a (lcd_fb_show_number_2digit); some modes write 0xFF or 0xF0 here instead.

fields.name: tens_glyph_b
fields.description: Tens digit segment byte B in the low nibble (OR-ed in by lcd_fb_show_number_2digit); bits 4..6 are icon group A (mask 0x70).

fields.name: tens_glyph_c
fields.description: Tens digit segment byte C from glyph table seg_c; some modes write 0x3F or 0xFF here.

fields.name: icon_bank_c9
fields.description: Icon bits: bits 4..6 (0x70) are icon group A (shared with tens_glyph_b and units_glyph_b), bits 0..1 are set by lcd_fb_set_c9_low2.

fields.name: units_glyph_a
fields.description: Units digit segment byte A from glyph table seg_a (written by lcd_fb_show_digit_units).

fields.name: units_glyph_b
fields.description: Units digit segment byte B in the low nibble (glyph table seg_b); bits 4..6 are icon group A.

fields.name: units_glyph_c
fields.description: Units digit segment byte C from glyph table seg_c; the mode pattern can set it to 0xCC.

fields.name: seg_bank_cd
fields.description: Low nibble is a segment pattern (0xC or 0x3) set by lcd_fb_set_cd_low_nibble; bits 4..6 are icon group B (0x70).

VcuLedPatternRow.description: One row of the LED row-animation tables. In the index tables the first byte is the entry count and bytes 1..9 are LED frame byte indices; in the mask tables byte 0 is unused and bytes 1..9 are bit masks.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of valid entries in the row (index tables). Unused in the mask tables.

fields.name: entry
fields.description: Entry k (1..9): LED frame byte index in the index tables or the bit mask in the mask tables.
